_설명: 천일문 3권 Chapter 02 조동사 Chapter Test 뒷부분(17~21번)에서 가져와 변형한 문항. 심화 4과 조동사 자리에 합쳐 둔다.

points.point: used to+동사원형: ~하곤 했다 (be used to와 구별)
must/may/cannot have p.p.: 과거 일에 대한 추측

questions.prompt: 다음 중 <보기>의 밑줄 친 used to와 쓰임이 같은 것 두 개를 고르세요.
body: <보기> My dad [[used to]] run a small shop.

choices.text: This machine is used to dry the clothes.
There used to be a bakery on this street.
I’m used to waking up early every morning.
They used to play badminton in their free time.
Lemons were used to make drinks and desserts.

questions.prompt: 다음 글을 읽고 주어진 단어를 사용하여 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰세요.
body: Mia won the singing contest. She ________________. (must, practice, a lot)

questions.prompt: 다음 글을 읽고 주어진 단어를 사용하여 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰세요.
body: Tom broke his dad’s favorite mug, but he tried to hide it. It made his dad angry.
He ________________. (should, his dad, tell the truth, to)
questions.answer: should have told the truth to his dad

questions.prompt: 짝지어진 두 문장의 의미가 다른 것을 모두 고르세요.

choices.text: Jason used to swim every weekend. = Every weekend, Jason would swim.
You must not be late for class. = You don’t have to be late for class.
The problem can be solved if we work together. = The problem may be solved if we work together.
It must have snowed last night. The roof is white. = The roof is white. It should have snowed last night.
We could finish the report before the deadline. = We were able to finish the report before the deadline.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞은 문장의 개수를 고르세요.
body: ⓐ She cannot have done it alone.
ⓑ They are used to speaking in Chinese.
ⓒ John may seen have the film before.
ⓓ We should have not wasted our time.
ⓔ I would often visit my cousins when I was young.
ⓕ You had better reading more books.
